features.quote: An ALL-IN-ONE experience featuring 6 official rooms and 6 unique Kizomba vibes.
features.rationale: The description calls the event an all-in-one experience held at the Logis Hôtel Lyon Est venue, matching the all-in-one feature.
The event has six official dance rooms, so more than one dance room is present.
The event offers more than 30 hours of workshops, which are dance classes.
